meta.name: Mahoutsukai no Yoru
meta.description:
Aoko Aozaki, an ordinary high school girl, is actually a Magician who lives in the modern world...though she is still only an apprentice. As she spends her days living alongside her housemate, Alice Kuonji, striving to become a full-fledged Magician...

The girl meets a boy.

This is the beginning of one young girl’s story — the tale of a Witch.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
